caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a teapot. The teapot is rendered in black and white using pencil on a plain, light-colored background. It has a large rounded body with a flattened circular base. The body of the teapot features an ornate decorative emblem or crest centered on its side, which appears to contain a stylized animal, possibly a lion, surrounded by intricate scrolling patterns. The teapot's handle is large, curved, and extends up and out from the side, with a thick, defined grip. The spout is elongated and curves upward, flaring out at the end. The domed lid fits snugly on top of the teapot and has a small knob on top, with some additional decorative details and markings just below the knob. The drawing uses shading and highlights to suggest the reflective metallic surface of the teapot, emphasizing its rounded form and three-dimensionality. The entire composition is centered within a rectangular border drawn on the paper.
title: Silver Teapot
